newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos granted Indonesian gas permit.
newsitem.headline: Santos granted Indonesian gas permit.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Tuesday it had been awarded a 61.111 percent interest in the Korinci Baru Production Sharing Contract (PSC) in central Sumatra in Indonesia.

Santos already has the same stake in the adjoining Bentu PSC which contains gross gas reserves of about 200 billion cubic feet. The Bentu projected is located about 800 km (500 miles) northwest of Jakarta.
The remaining interest in both PSCs is held by Apache Corp, which is also the operator of both contracts.

Santos said in a statement exploration could show further increases in gas reserves, with test wells drilled in the 1960s and 1970s finding gas at shallow levels in geology similar to the Bentu project.
Seismic testing and establishing markets would be among the company's main priorities for the project.
"We are very pleased to be awarded this interest," managing director Ross Adler said in a statement.
"It is a further step in positioning Santos to take advantage of the growing domestic gas market in Indonesia."
